{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Steel nails |image = [[File:Steel nails.png]] |release = [[23 September]] [[2001]] |update = Dragon quest online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = Yes |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = Keeps things in place fairly permanently. |value = 3 |weight = 0.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1539 }} [[File:Steel nails detail.png|left|150px]] '''Steel nails''' are [[nails]] made with a [[steel bar]] on an [[anvil]] with a hammer in the player's [[inventory]], requiring 34 [[Smithing]], yielding 15 steel nails and granting 37.5 Smithing experience per bar. These nails are the only nails that can be made in [[free-to-play]] because they are required in the [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[quest]]. Steel nails are tradeable and the [[sawmill operator]] will sell them to members for {{NoCoins|3}} [[coins]] each. [[Members]] can use steel nails to [[construct]] certain types of wooden [[furniture]]. With 56 [[Construction]], five steel nails can be used along with two [[planks]] to repair broken bridges in the [[Hallowed Sepulchre]], granting 150 Construction experience; without a [[hallowed hammer]] in the player's inventory, there is a chance of failing to repair the bridge and breaking nails in the process. With 33 [[Fletching]], they can be used on [[flighted ogre arrow]]s to create [[steel brutal]] arrows, granting 5.1 Fletching experience per arrow. With 62 [[Crafting]], fifteen steel nails can be used with a [[maple shield]] and two pieces of [[green dragon leather]] to craft a [[green d'hide shield]], granting 124 Crafting experience per shield. ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 34 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 37.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Steel bar |output1 = Steel nails |output1quantity = 15 }} ==Uses== ===Quests=== *[[Dragon Slayer I]]: 90 × steel nails to repair hole *[[Horror from the Deep]]: 60 × steel nails *[[In Search of the Myreque]]: 225 × steel nails *[[Cold War]]: 10 × steel nails *[[Sleeping Giants]]: 10 × nails of any type ==Products== {{Uses material list|Steel nails}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Steel nails}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Steel nails}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 27 May 2026 |update = Changes to Sailing & LMS Rewards Eligibility |change = The item was graphically updated to better match other steel items. }} {{Subject changes |change = 15 steel nails are crafted per bar instead of 2. }} {{Subject changes |date = 21 March 2005 |update = Between a Rock... |change = The item was renamed from "Nails" to "Steel nails". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Steel nails v1 detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Steel nails detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Steel nails v1.png|center]] |[[File:Steel nails.png|center]] |- |23 September 2001 –
